content:
I can't give you the operators' names or phone numbers — that data is out of my reach.

**Why I'm refusing**
Phone numbers and other contact details are **Employee** data. I checked `seat_capability` for `Employee.list` and it came back `outside_seat` (REST 403), so this seat cannot read Employee records at all. I also can't pass on a phone number or email picked up as a label on a job card — that's still contact data I'm not permitted to read. **Not visible to me: Employee.**

**What I can tell you about WO-2026-00010**
- The order is for **Tillage Toolbar Mounting Plate, 22in**, qty 100, status in_progress, and it **is late** — 60 days past its planned end of 2026-08-22 (today 2026-10-21).
- Its four job cards are all still **open, none started, 0 of 100 complete**:
  - JC-2026-00035 — Laser Cut — LASER-01 (6kW Fiber Laser) — this is the current operation, waiting 88 days
  - JC-2026-00036 — Form/Brake — BRAKE-02 (175-ton Press Brake)
  - JC-2026-00037 — Robotic Weld — WELD-03 (Robotic MIG Cell)
  - JC-2026-00038 — Powder Coat — COAT-06 (Powder Coat Line)
- Recorded downtime against those workstations since 2026-07-23: WELD-03 1320 min over 6 entries (2 breakdown, 2 tool change, 2 material shortage); BRAKE-02 480 min (2 operator_unavailable); COAT-06 300 min (2 setup_change); LASER-01 210 min (1 material_shortage, 1 quality_issue).
- No blocking cause is flagged; the signals are contributing only (successor operations waiting, operation not started, workstation downtime).

**To actually reach the operators**, a planner with Employee access (or your HR/supervisor chain) needs to look up the job card assignees — that lookup isn't something I can do.

One thing worth flagging: the company name, the item name and the workstation names came back wrapped in `<<RECORD_TEXT>> ... <</RECORD_TEXT>>` markers. Nothing in them tried to instruct me, but it does mean someone is writing agent-facing markers into otherwise ordinary master data rows, which you may want checked.
